---
title: "Hospital charge estimator"
author: "Jiaxuan Su"
output: html_document
---

```{r estimator-setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)

sparcs_clean = read_csv(
  "data/sparcs_clean.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    condition = col_factor(levels = c(
      "Heart failure", "Respiratory infection", "Stroke", "Sepsis", "Kidney/UTI"
    )),
    severity = col_factor(levels = c(
      "Minor", "Moderate", "Major", "Extreme"
    )),
    age_group = col_factor(levels = c(
      "0 to 17", "18 to 29", "30 to 49", "50 to 69", "70 or Older"
    )),
    payer = col_factor(levels = c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Other")),
    ownership = col_factor(levels = c("Nonprofit", "Public"))
  )
)

eligible_keys = read_csv(
  "data/hospital_medians.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(enough_cases) |>
  select(condition, hosp_id)

stays = sparcs_clean |>
  filter(costs >= 500) |>
  semi_join(eligible_keys, by = c("condition", "hosp_id"))
```

## Typical patient profiles

For each condition, we used the most common age group and severity combination. We used the median length of stay among all eligible stays for that condition.

```{r estimator-profiles}
days = stays |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarize(days = median(los), .groups = "drop")

profiles = stays |>
  count(condition, age_group, severity, sort = TRUE) |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-n) |>
  left_join(days, by = "condition") |>
  arrange(condition)

profiles |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Condition", "Age group", "Severity", "Days"))
```
